SGBS preadipocytes were grown to full confluency in basal culture medium, consisting of supplemented Dulbecco’s modified Eagle’s F12 (DMEM/F12; Gibco; supplements: 33 μM biotin (Sigma-Aldrich), 17 μM panthothenate (Sigma-Aldrich), 100 U/l penicillin/streptomycin (Sigma-Aldrich), and 10% fetal calf serum (FCS; Gibco)).
preadipocytes were pelleted by centrifugation at 500g for 10 min, followed by resuspension in growth medium (DMEM/F12 + 10% FCS + 1% Zellshield).
After centrifugation, cells were suspended in culture medium (DMEM containing 10% FCS, 1% penicillin/streptomycin, and 25 μg/mL sodium ascorbate), seeded, and maintained at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
